scope: Read-only independent numerical audit of the completed 129-frame GPU peak window. This review JSON is the only newly written file; no solver, notifier, Git operation or change to retained evidence was performed.

provenance_audit.scope: All explicit bound file entries in status/run/check/prepared/completion and the bound Release build record, including native output hashes; unrelated historical JSON trees were not recursively opened.
provenance_audit.ownership_check: No process with recorded sequence/wrapper PIDs 51300 or 33896 and no GPU solver for cryer_grad_peak_r1 was found at review. No process was stopped by the reviewer.

native_audit.safety_method: The retained original inspect() guard was applied to every reread frame, with the original finite, positive-density, no-exclusion, elastic, state-precision, actual-load, drainage, mechanical-step and pore-step checks; the mass/h and radius guards were also explicitly rechecked. The original guard was reused, not presented as a separately redesigned physical safety model.

summary_recalculation.method: Original summary quantities were recomputed from native fields. The regional radial stress was independently expanded from diagonal and shear tensor entries; its machine-rounding difference explains the reported maximum discrepancy. This rounding comparison is an analysis consistency test, not a relaxed physical gate.
summary_recalculation.region_definition: Fixed initial center ball r0<=dp+1e-12; interior r0<R-2h; outer shell r0>=R-2h. Center is a subset of interior. Only interior plus outer shell form a disjoint whole-domain partition.
summary_recalculation.theory_check_scope: The declared Cv was checked against the explicit material formula and the stored theory values were recomputed at actual saved times using the bound 360-root theory helper. This is not a second independent derivation or validation of the analytical series. The declared theory gravity reference is 9.81 m/s2.

shared_sample_exception: dterror_s is the sole interval-statistic exclusion because output intervals differ. Both original dterror<=1e-14-s guards were checked independently. Actual times, saved steps and every other native field remain exactly equal; no physical-field or time-alignment exception was applied.

verified_sampled_outcomes.mandel_window_rule: All saved samples Tv>=0.005 through the bounded final time, without smoothing or filtering.

limitations: The retained independent half-step and cross-backend evidence covers only the earlier five-sample startup window, not this entire peak window.
This is one GPU timestep over 0.0625 s, not a peak-window half-step or full-cycle acceptance. The two shared samples do not constitute an entire dense fine prefix.

Full-history and Mandel-window maxima above are maxima among saved samples, not guaranteed continuous-time extrema. The earlier startup maximum is distinct from the later declared Mandel-window maximum.

The native center observable averages 18 fixed material particles, whereas the analytical reference is a point-center solution. Native initial pressure is zero while the quasi-static theoretical t0+ limit is q.
Different transient regional total stresses are verified observations, not by themselves proof of an incorrect mechanical balance or an accepted physical correction.
No physical equations, precision state, mass, geometry, damping, traction, formal inputs or thresholds were changed by this audit, and no new run or notifier was started.
